section_summary.extract_value: Study 2 describes a confirmatory factor analysis of the CEMS (Caregiver Eating Messages Scale) in a different sample to validate its factor structure. The study also examines associations between caregiver eating messages, negative body attitudes, and maladaptive eating behaviors.
